note: coefficients = c(beta, zeta) of polr(y ~ x, method = logistic | probit | cloglog) polished to the MLE by Newton on the analytic gradient / Hessian (polr reltol 1e-14 agrees to 1e-6); vcov = the inverse analytic observed information (classical) or the hc0 / hc1 / cluster (CR1) sandwich on the per-row scores; deviance = -2 loglik, null_deviance = the thresholds-only fit's; fitted_probabilities = weighted mean P(Y = k | x); brant = brant::brant's statistic with the binary glms at their fixed point (omnibus, per-term); row_eta = x'beta and row_probabilities = P(Y = k | x) per row (predict(polr, type = 'probs') agrees to 1e-6). rows [x..., y, w, g]; holdout = the weighted proper scores of the holdout_rows [x..., y, w, g] at the MLE: log_loss = mean -ln P(y), brier = mean sum_k (P_k - [y = k])^2, accuracy = mean [first argmax = y], rps = mean sum_{k<K} (F_k - [y <= k])^2 / (K - 1). weight '' (w = 1), frequency (= the rep() expansion) or probability (w* = w n_eff / sum w). exponentiated = the predictors' exp(beta), exp(beta) SE and exp(beta -/+ qnorm(0.975) SE) on the case's covariance. nominal_test = 2 (loglik partial - loglik po) of the partial proportional-odds fit (one predictor, then every predictor, non-parallel; ordinal::nominal_test / clm agree to 1e-6) polished to its MLE; null when the partial fit does not converge or crosses (nominal_test$failed).
